facts.fact: 章首：苏醒——耳鸣嘈杂浑身剧痛被暗影绑着竖直吊在墙上
facts.anchor: Sound buzzed through Andra’s mind as she slowly drifted back to consciousness, an undercurrent of jumbled noises

facts.fact: 记忆核对：雪地那幕真实——可眼前的 Gerrick 活着
facts.anchor: No, this memory was hers, she was sure of it. Gerrick lying in the snow, crimson blood pooling on his chest

facts.fact: 衣衫染血但皮肤无伤——他已被治愈（治愈者=Vasara）
facts.anchor: They were bloodied and torn, exposing the skin of his chest underneath. Skin that bore no sign of injury.

facts.fact: Vasara 点破：没料到她来得这么"自愿"——Gerrick 的"劝说"之功；"该我履约了"
facts.anchor: “I must admit, Gerrick, I did not plan on her coming so willingly, even with your persuasion.”

facts.fact: Gerrick 放弃报酬只求放母亲+放 Andra——"其余都不要"
facts.anchor: “Free my mother, and keep the rest.” Gerrick never took his eyes off Andra. “I don’t want it. Let Andra go.”

facts.fact: Vasara 摊牌：从未抓过他母亲——谎称只为骗他来
facts.anchor: “I never had your mother, darling.” She waved a careless hand. “I merely told you I had her to get you here.

facts.fact: 三十年前：仆人送来"最不寻常的东西"——一个男婴
facts.anchor: Three decades ago, a servant brought me the most unusual thing. Do you know what that was, hunter?

facts.fact: 杀婴令：让仆人一刀刺穿那婴儿的心脏
facts.anchor: I told the servant to run a blade through that baby’s heart.

facts.fact: 纹身释义：每杀一只同类怪物纹身就长——标记背叛引同类追杀
facts.anchor: When you slay one of your own, a tattoo appears, correct? This physical manifestation marks your betrayal

facts.fact: 身份判决：生于深渊最黑暗处的私生子——怪物大厅四周涌出围守待命
facts.anchor: Like it or not, hunter, you are one of them. Born a bastard in the darkest part of the pit itself.”

facts.fact: 章末悬念：已得到所需没理由留他活命——怪物们各向前一步
facts.anchor: Yet somehow, here you are, and now that I have what I need from you there is no reason to keep you alive.

facts.fact: 最后一屏：她决意不再压抑情绪任其全部释放——绑缚微微松脱
facts.anchor: Emotions boiled under the surface of her skin, and she was no longer interested in locking them up tight
